facts.fact: UNICEF reports the tablet-based digital birth registration system under the Ntlafatsa Bana project, launched at Ha-Tankele, is integrated with NISSA, Lesotho's national social assistance database, in real time.

systems.owner: Government of Lesotho, EU and UNICEF project

note: as_of is the document's published date; it gives no earlier date for the integration.
